product.name: Sigma 14-24mm F2.8 Art DG DN, Mount for Sony E
product.description: Sigma 14-24mm F2.8 Art DG DN is a newly-designed lens series made for Leica L-Mount and Sony E-Mount full-frame mirrorless cameras. This wide-angle zoom lens has a fast f/2.8 constant maximum aperture that is ideal for working under varying lighting conditions. It has a series of low dispersion and aspherical elements that minimize both chromatic and spherical aberrations throughout the zoom range, rendering clear, sharp, and color-accurate photos. Its lens elements are coated with a Super Multi-Layer Coating and a NanoPorous Coating (NPC) to help suppress lens flare and ghosting better compared to conventional anti-reflective coatings. This gives you better color accuracy and sharp contrasts in your images under various lighting conditions. It also has a rounded 11-blade diaphragm that helps produce smooth bokeh and comes with a lens hood to protect the front element and help prevent lens flare.
